name: to-slack
description: Draft a Slack message in markdown and copy it so Slack formats it on paste (macOS)

interface.shortDescription: Markdown that pastes into Slack with real headings, lists and tables
interface.longDescription: Drafts a Slack message from the conversation, shows it for approval, then puts it on the macOS clipboard as markdown, HTML and optionally Slack Block Kit, so Cmd+V in Slack gives real formatting, native tables included.
